scenes.text: This is Ghostty Sessions. It's a small panel that sits next to Ghostty and keeps track of every Claude Code session you have open.
Each row is one session. A turning ring means Claude is still working. When Claude finishes, the row moves up to Needs you, so you know it's your turn.
If Claude stops to ask for permission, the row turns red and shows the exact command it wants to run. You also get a notification, and the menu bar shows the count.
Click a row, and Ghostty jumps straight to that tab, ready for you to type. Once you've seen it, the session moves down to Idle.
Or press Control, Option, Space from anywhere, to jump to the session that has waited longest.
Sessions start in your code folder and move between repos. Expand a card to see every repo it touched, and the branch in each one.
To start something new, type the task right here. Ghostty Sessions opens a new tab, and Claude gets to work.
And Ghostty itself stays untouched. There's no fork. Ghostty Sessions only uses Ghostty's own scripting, so every Ghostty update just works.
